description: Source code implementing a stack emulation for Adobe's CFF font processing, including stack initialization, push, pop, and utility functions.

methods.name: cf2_stack_init
methods.description: Initializes a CF2_Stack instance, allocating memory and setting up the stack.

methods.name: cf2_stack_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a CF2_Stack instance.

methods.name: cf2_stack_count
methods.description: Returns the number of items currently on the stack.

methods.name: cf2_stack_pushInt
methods.description: Pushes an integer value onto the stack.

methods.name: cf2_stack_pushFixed
methods.description: Pushes a fixed-point value onto the stack.

methods.name: cf2_stack_popInt
methods.description: Pops an integer value from the stack, with error handling for underflow and type mismatch.

methods.name: cf2_stack_popFixed
methods.description: Pops a fixed-point value from the stack, with silent casting for type mismatch.

methods.name: cf2_stack_getReal
methods.description: Retrieves a real (fixed-point) value from the stack at a specified index, with silent casting.

methods.name: cf2_stack_clear
methods.description: Clears the stack, resetting the top pointer.
